moments.text: Infrared sensor view of a grey scene, brighter above and darker below, with faint ring-shaped blotches fixed on the picture.
A long bright streak sweeps right to left along the top of the view. A tiny white dot shows just right of the crosshair.
The tiny white dot drifts above the crosshair, first to its upper left, then its upper right.
More bright streaks slide right to left across the lower part of the view; the dot moves in from the upper right toward the crosshair.
The view jumps to a closer, flat grey picture with faint vertical bands; the dot, left of the crosshair, drifts further left and up.
The wider view with ring blotches returns; the dot sits upper left, then moves to just above the crosshair and stays near it.
The picture shifts to a smooth gradient, dark lower left and bright upper right; the dot is no longer visible.
The picture flashes white, then turns blocky grey.
A long stretch of plain gradient, bright at the top and darker lower left, with no object standing out.
A run of flashes and jumps: white, dark blocky frames, a bright textured view, then a dim grey one.
The bright-top gradient view returns, with a small redaction box below the crosshair, to the end.
